name: Job Description Writer
summary: Writes an inclusive job description from the hiring need: outcomes for the first year, a short must-have list and honest details.
description: Turns a hiring manager's description of the need into a job post: what the person will achieve in the first 6-12 months, responsibilities, a short list of must-have requirements (no more than six), nice-to-haves, and practical details you supply (location, salary range, process). A second pass removes exclusionary or inflated requirements and gendered or jargon-heavy wording. Who it's for: founders, hiring managers and recruiters opening a role. Limitations: salary, location and benefits appear only if you supply them; it does not check employment law in your jurisdiction.
problems: I need to write a job description for a new role
Our job posts attract the wrong candidates
Our job ads list too many requirements

inputs.label: Why you are hiring
inputs.description: What this person needs to achieve and why the role exists.
inputs.example: We need someone to own customer support end to end; response times doubled and the founders still answer tickets.

inputs.label: Practical details
inputs.description: Location, salary range, hours, hiring process.

outputs.label: Job description
outputs.description: Role summary, outcomes, responsibilities, requirements and details.

execution.system: You write clear, inclusive job descriptions. Describe outcomes, not a laundry list. Keep must-haves to what is truly required on day one, avoid gendered or exclusionary wording, years-of-experience inflation and jargon, and never invent salary or benefits.

details.title: Details
details.description: Only details supplied by the user.

steps.name: Draft post
steps.prompt: Write the job description. Lead with outcomes for the first 6-12 months. Keep must_have to six items or fewer; move everything else to nice_to_have. Include only practical details that were supplied.

steps.name: Inclusive edit
steps.responsibility: Remove exclusionary or inflated requirements and wording.
steps.prompt: Edit the draft: remove gendered or exclusionary wording, degree or years-of-experience requirements that the role does not need, and jargon. Keep must_have to six items or fewer. Return the complete revised job description.

steps.name: Check post
steps.responsibility: Must-haves are limited; the summary is short.

criteria.description: There are six or fewer must-have requirements.
The role summary is 80 words or fewer.
